node.statement: Uniform target-corner product separation. There are universal c_prod,c_cross<infinity and e_corner>0 such that, at every amplification and for e=rho+epsilon<=e_corner, if U lies in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k} and V lies in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, then for k=l one has ||UV-U dot V||<=c_prod e||U||||V||, while for k!=l one has ||UV||<=c_cross e||U||||V||. This is a consequence only of def-compressed-corner, target rho-complementarity in def-four-corner-merging-datum, and the matrix-level epsilon-C*-axioms in def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra.
